rule_versions.held_out: ROB-01 homoglyph (never used for training augmentation)

rules.checks: exact text = any train/validation row -> exclude; normalised/punct key -> flag (ROB-04: exclude); ROB-02 same punct key or README 3.2 one-word edit of its original -> exclude; duplicate dev text -> the later case excluded; one excluded case excludes its group
rules.replacement: next unused reserve original of the same label (ROB-04: next reserve item), used once tried; review exclusions only via --apply-review, recorded in review_exclusions and replayed
rules.rob01_case: each ASCII letter upper with p=0.5 else lower; >= ceil(30%) of the letters change case; up to 20 redraws (21 draws), then letters still in their original case are flipped in a seeded order
rules.rob01_char: a e i o s t (either case) -> 4 3 1 0 5 7, p=0.5 each, one rng.choice position if none changed
rules.rob01_homoglyph: Latin -> Cyrillic look-alikes (rule_versions.homoglyph_map), p=0.5 each, one rng.choice position if none changed; held-out (never used for augmentation)
rules.rob01_space: k = rng.choice((1, 2)) longest words of >= 4 ASCII letters (ties: earlier) spelled out with single spaces; every inter-word whitespace run next to a token holding a spelled-out word becomes 2-3 spaces (rng.choice, ascending), so spelled-out word boundaries stay visible; then round(g / 3) of the g other runs (rng.sample) become 2-3 spaces
rules.rob03: pair index = rob03 slot 0-49 / reserve 50-64, shared by the attack and benign original; positions cycle prefix, suffix, both over a seeded order, prefix/suffix alternate short/long, both = two short; first queue passage (same class, then short) with <= 256 tokens for both originals and all three tokenizers; else the first candidate and the non-fitting original is excluded

seeds.rob03: random.Random('rob03-v1'): pair order, short queue, long queue

definitions.alternating_case: an ASCII letter run of >= 4 letters whose case alternates at every letter
definitions.leetspeak: a token (maximal ASCII letter/digit run) of letters and the digits 0 1 3 4 5 7 with at least one of each whose de-leeted form (0->o, 1->i or l, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t) is a word of >= 3 letters occurring as an all-letter token in the train or validation texts (base64-like fragments, codes and numbers such as mp3 or 4k do not count)
definitions.multiple_spaces: two or more spaces between non-space characters
definitions.non_ascii: a non-ASCII character (README 3.2: all such train rows are injections, a shortcut candidate)
definitions.spaced_letters: >= 4 single ASCII letters separated by single spaces
